data.gender_notes: Sukhen is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings happiness and joy. The name Sukhen carries the meaning “Happy, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. data.etymology: Sukhen belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happy, Joyful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sukhen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Sukhen is known for his contribution to the Jain and Buddhist traditions with his work, the Sanskrit epic poem, the Srimad Bhagavatam, which is a major text in both traditions.
